Results.ReviewText: We are a long-time Weber grill family. This newest one was an upgrade and has some great features, such as: removable center grill; better ash collection; warming grill and easy touch handles.
Results.Title: We Love Weber

Results.ReviewText: J’ai acheté il y a quelques semaines et je m’en suis beaucoup servie.
Results.Title: Très stable

Results.ReviewText: It’s great for grilling and smoking, didn’t think I would love it so much
Results.Title: Weber Mastertouch just perfect

Results.ReviewText: Ease of use, shuts down quickly to save charcoal and is built to last. Love it...
Results.Title: Weber Master-Touch 22” Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Best Kettle package. Versatile ability to grill and slow cook. Get the rotisserie and your all set. My last kettle gave 23 years of heavy use. That's value.
Results.Title: Master-Touch Fan!

Results.ReviewText: The grill was easy to assemble, and much easier to clean up after a cook compared to my last Weber grill. I added a cover to keep it clean when not in use. The top vent handle is very easy to use and the bottom vents are great with the markings to allow for partial open vs. full open vs. full closed. The one thing I tried that didn't work was only removing the center of the cooking grate and trying to use the Weber chimney to start the coals... the handle of the chimney leaned on the outer cooking grate to make it not sit level. Not a big deal.
Results.Title: Very Happy with Weber Master Touch

Results.ReviewText: Great product. I purchased this as an addition to another Weber I already have.
Results.Title: Master touch

Results.ReviewText: Since i bought this grill I really look forward to grilling all the time. Trying different foods and techniques to bbq.
Results.Title: Awesome bbq

Results.ReviewText: Assembly was simple with very little drama.  I have cooked on it twice since purchased.  The coals stayed hot and burned very evenly.  The master-touch cleaning was useful and it encourages keeping the grill cleaner than other grills I have owned in the past.  I really like the lid rack on this model.  My only issue has been that the circular opening in the grill rack is a little tricky to remove and replace when you load the hot coals.  I am very happy with this grill and look forward to many years of grilling.
Results.Title: First Weber Grill after years of kettle grilling

Results.ReviewText: There is nothing better for outdoor cooking than a Weber 22” kettle. My neighbors all compliment how the smell of the  food makes it feel like that season of the year. They also compliment the taste of the chicken and steaks.
Results.Title: Weber 22” kettles are the best!

Results.ReviewText: This is a really good grill. I don’t have any issues controlling the temp. I love the different attachments for the center grate. I also recommend getting a vortex for your kettle. It gives you so many different cooking options.
Results.Title: Kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: Really a good bbq! We enjoy ours new purchase , reccomand
Results.Title: Bbq

Results.ReviewText: Quality product that performs well. Great addition to my outdoor cooking options.
Results.Title: Quality grill

Results.ReviewText: As someone that has had a gas grill for the last 7 years, I was a bit nervous having to deal with the process of cooking with charcoal. Gas was nice to just turn on, get it hot, then throw meat on it. I worried that it would take time to learn how to cook with charcoal and not be worth it. Well I can say that this was by far the best purchase I have made in years. I use the charcoal chimney and get the grill ready to go in 15 minutes. The flavor of charcoal is phenomenal and it really isn't that much more prep work. It also has become a ritual that my wife and I enjoy so all in all an excellent purchase. It didn't take too much time to learn meat placement on and how to position the coals around the grill. I do love the master-touch grill additions like lid holder and ash catcher. I thought people were full of it recommending a weber brand charcoal grill but let me just say, there is a reason they recommend this brand.
Results.Title: Best purchase I've made coming from gas!

Results.ReviewText: Very versatile, easy to clean and has enough space to cook two zones at the same time.
Results.Title: Versatile

Results.ReviewText: Great grill it's much improved over the years. I bought my last one in the late 80's. There's so much you can cook on this grill and i just love the new colors
Results.Title: Grillmaster

Results.ReviewText: It's really quite a wonderful and versatile grill and there's so many attachments you could get for it a rotisserie etc and it makes really fine tasting food. There's nothing like cooking on a grill with lump charcoal.
Results.Title: Very happy I purchased this grill

Results.ReviewText:
The Weber Master-Touch has proved to an amazing tool for putting the meat on the heat.  

Starting from putting it together, it was quick and easy.  It holds heat very well and done great with ribs, steaks, chicken, sausages and fajitas. 

The ash catcher makes cleaning a breeze.  The adjustable grates make it very easy to add briquettes when needed.  

I would highly recommend this grill for anyone who wants to put the meat on the heat.
Results.Title: Put the meat on the heat with the Weber Master-Tou

Results.ReviewText: Stop wasting money on $1000 pellet smokers. You can buy better pre cooked meat at Walmart. Weber kettle is and will always be the best, most reliable, and efficient grill on the market.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: This is an amazing culinary device! My only comment less than completely positive concerns the shift in center-of-gravity w/risk of dumping backwards when lifting too high by the front handle to move the grill. Perhaps it’s just me and my model with the heavy upgraded stainless steel cooking grate and warming rack, but when I lift by handle to move the grill, I can’t really lift more than like 1/2-1” without it starting to feel top heavy and unstable. I think a small counter weight option on the front leg would be a good idea to address this without making a design change. Weber, please consider me for a royalty should you use this idea!  Other than that small observation, I love my Weber and consider it one of the best investments I’ve ever made.
Results.Title: One Observation Only

Results.ReviewText: This is the second grill I have owned. My fist lasted 15 years. It was still in great shape except I lost the lid in a wind storm. I love this grill. Great build and great for cooking on.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I love my grill. I’ve wanted one for years and I guess stuck with gas until that grill was no longer useable.
Results.Title: I like it

Results.ReviewText: I had ordered a Weber Master-Touch but the bottom bowl arrived damaged. I contacted Weber customer support and they sent me a new bowl fast. Now after using the grill for several weeks, I can say that the Master-Touch is an awesome grill!
Results.Title: Awesome grill and Awesome customer service

Results.ReviewText:
We love ❤️ our new master touch grill. The ocean blue color looks beautiful on the patio. And we love the grilled food. 
Arrived by FedEx couple days after ordering from Weber.
Was easier to put together from the directions than from the couple you tubes I watched. They sure love to hear themselves talk on YouTube. (And I should add that I'm an old granny that's not used to putting things like this together.)
Our house came with a built in expensive brand natural gas BBQ which we only used once in 8 years because we missed the taste of charcoal grilled food. We regretted giving away our old charcoal grill when we moved. 
Now we're grilling every couple days and wish we bought this weber few years ago. We won't be in any hurry to go to restaurants once they open again.
Waiting for the blue to be back in stock so I can buy it for my daughters family.
We are very happy we bought this grill.
Results.Title: Love my new grill

Results.ReviewText: L'hiver je cuisine sur le Genesis, mais j'ai hâte au printemps pour utiliser le master-touch.
Results.Title: Facile d'utilisation

ClientResponses.Response: Hi, We are sorry for the bad experience. The new lid and bowl will come in 7-10 business days. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Lid came in dented. 1 star for what arrived. Will see if replacements better
Results.Title: Bowl had welding marks on outside.

ClientResponses.Response: Hi, We are sorry you had a bad experience. We have sent you a new bowl to help you with this issue. You should receive it 7-10 business days. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I enjoy the added features over the first basic 22” silver model. However the quality of my master touch doesn’t show premium. The handle is welded on crooked and there is a 2” patch of raised coating in the bottom section of the bowl that sits in the path of the one touch cleaning blades. Does it change how it grills no but is it Weber quality that should be proud of maybe not.
Results.Title: Nice added features but quality isn’t there

Results.ReviewText: Loved it, and the customer service is fantastic, I received a part that has a little damage and the issue was fixed almost instantly. I already used the Master-Touch Grill and I'm super happy with it!
Results.Title: Happy client! This grill is really good

Results.ReviewText: I love it!! Is the best!! I use every weekend and I’m so happy
Results.Title: Amazing grill

Results.ReviewText: good grill, along with add-ons and accessories, the steaks are wonderful
Results.Title: Excellent quality

Results.ReviewText: Très variés le type utilisation que l'on peut faire avec ce bbq
Results.Title: Super achat

Results.ReviewText: Love having the extra room over my Weber 18 inch grill which I still use also
Results.Title: GREAT Grill

Results.ReviewText: Vraiment content de ma première expérience pour un Bbq au charbon. C'est un peu plus apprentissage mais avec le mastertouch ce sera agréable.
Results.Title: Un vrai happening !

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill.   Cooks great and easy to clean.  Much more versatile than many charcoal grills.
Results.Title: Master-touch Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have and have had a LOT of grills in my 50 years of grilling and barbecuing, all degrees of prices. The absolute best “bang for the buck” is the Weber kettle grill. In the same breath, a Weber gas grill is, IMHO, the very best gas grill you can buy.
Results.Title: Weber 22” Master Touch

Results.ReviewText: Definitely worth the price to upgrade to the Master-Touch. This kettle is taller and sturdier than my basic Weber Kettle, and the features like the higher quality grates, second-level rack, cover holder, and cover improvements make this upgrade a no-brainer. Very happy with my purchase!
Results.Title: Definitely worth the price to upgrade!

Results.ReviewText: After 30 plus years of cooking with gas, I got back into charcoal with Weber’s Smokey Joe and then the Jumbo Joe but nothing compares to the 22” One Touch.  I love it. Plenty of room to cook and I love the blue color I ordered.  Extremely happy with my purchase.
Results.Title: Can’t beat a Weber

Results.ReviewText: Great pit does everything I need, I have 2 other pits and have not used them since....only problem is the grill grate in the center falls off to easily...it need something to hold it in place
Results.Title: Can't stop using this grill

Results.ReviewText: J,ai fait quelques bon steak et pizza sur le grill. Le résultat est excellent. En plus d'être jolie ce BBQ fonctionne à merveille.
Results.Title: Excellent

Results.ReviewText: Have always had gas grills until this. I love this grill and for the price, it's a great deal with it having the gourmet system in place.
Results.Title: Versatile

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
